'''Neain''' was [[Perrin]]'s aunt. She was married to [[Carlin]] before he passed away. She visits his grave everyday.

==Activities==
She lives on the Aybara farm with the rest of Perrin's family. [[Padan Fain]] murders Perrin's entire family including Neain. There deaths are blamed on [[Trolloc|Trollocs]].{{ref/book|4|29}}
